## 3. Stress test: scaling the endowments

A scale is reported as *resolved* only if the certainty equivalents agree to 1% (relative to the endowment scale) across (a) grid refinement 121x121/400 -> 241x241/800 and (b) domain enlargement L = 6 -> 10. Otherwise the numerical method has reached its limit; this is **not** evidence that no equilibrium exists.

| scale | scheme | lambda(0,0,0) | grid gap | domain gap | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.5 | central | 0.0935 | 3.3e-06 | 1.6e-11 | resolved |
| 0.5 | upwind | 0.0932 | 3.1e-04 | 2.0e-11 | resolved |

| 1 | upwind | 0.1789 | 2.1e-03 | 1.0e-10 | resolved |
